question: In which year was the first national athletic meet organised in New Delhi with the efforts of Dr. AC Noehren of YMCA Madras?
solution:
The correct answer is **1924.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Athletic Meet:-**

 
 
• ​The Indian Olympic movement was founded in the early 1920s, and India competed in the 1920 Olympics in Antwerp.
 
• By 1924, there was a provisional Indian Olympic Association (IOA), and the Indian Olympic Games were held in **Delhi in February 1924** to select Indian athletes for the Paris Olympics in 1924.
 
• The Indian Olympic Association, the nation's sports organizing body, proposed the idea of the National Games to encourage the growth of sports and the Olympic movement in India and selected the host city.
 
• The games were renamed the National Games at the 9th Games in Bombay in 1940, when they were held every two years.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dr. A.G. Noehren 

 
 
• Sir Dorabji Tata and **Dr. A.G. Noehren** served as the Founding President and **Secretary General **of the** ****IOA ****(Indian Olympic Association)** when it was established in 1927.
 
• **Dr. Noehren,** Secretary of the IOA, wrote the following about Indian Olympic games: Seventy athletes representing nearly every province and state in the Empire, including Hindus, Muslims, Anglo-Indians, and Sinhalese, ate their food around the same table and mingled intimately in the cramped and uncomfortable accommodations provided at the **All-India Athletic Carnival,** the greatest and most representative gathering of its kind ever to be held in India.
